deficiencies.description: The rewrite changes a remark about what the audience saw into a factual statement that the pre-cancerous states are present.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: You saw those different pre-cancerous states.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: The different pre-cancerous states are present,

deficiencies.description: The text describes cells as being 'for invading', indicating a potential or purpose, but the rewrite definitively states that they 'invade'.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: shedding cells for invading into other parts of the body.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: shedding cells that invade other parts of the body.

deficiencies.description: The rewrite narrows the claim that cervical screening is the best by restricting it only to the screening methods discussed.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: So screening, as I said, the cervix is best.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: Of the screening methods discussed, cervical screening is the best.

deficiencies.description: The rewrite adds a link ('such as') to indicate that showing symptoms is an example of a reason, which the text does not state.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: or there's some reason if you're showing symptoms.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: or some other reason, such as the patient showing symptoms.

deficiencies.description: The text contains a grammatically disconnected statement linking people who go for screening with a false positive rate. The rewrite makes this clear by choosing an interpretation that the people are 'affected by' the false positive rate.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: because many of the people that do go for screening and then for further treatment, it has a very, very high false positive rate.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: because many of the people who go for screening and then for further treatment are affected by a very high false positive rate.

considerations.sourcePassage: this is an ulcerated cauliflower structure,
considerations.reason: Adding '-like' to 'cauliflower' uses different words with exactly the same meaning.

considerations.sourcePassage: it has a very, very high false positive rate.
considerations.reason: Dropping the repetition of the word 'very' is an allowed change.

considerations.sourcePassage: It is not a very, very good test,
considerations.reason: Dropping the repetition of the word 'very' is an allowed change.
